description: Two-layer Kanban cards with a simplified human view and a flow guardian that audits the board
instructions: Requires the github-projects profile. Apply workflow/kanban-board.md and templates/kanban-card.md. Every card has a human cover (title, fields, a five-line Resumo in Portuguese rewritten on each Status change) and an agent sheet in English inside a details block. The nine Status values remain the contract; the human view groups them in the derived field Etapa (A fazer, Em andamento, Em validação, Aguardando você, Concluído). Etapa, Precisa de você and Gates are derived and corrected only by integrations/kanban/audit_board.py. product-owner owns entry quality (Definition of Ready); scrum-master owns the flow and runs the audit before every transition, at session start, at the end of each wave and before every human gate; each delivery owner updates its own card before acting and on delivery; validators record verdicts with the SHA; only the principal moves to completed and only the human to accepted. The scrum-master corrects derived fields through the script and charges owners for content; it never fills evidence, verdicts or checklists. Every Status change is a LOG STATUS comment. No specialist is dispatched without a card reference in the brief (line 'Card: owner/repo#N'); the guardrails mod enforces this when installed. One card per story, tasks as sub-issues.
